# Honeyhive

HoneyHive is a modern AI observability and evaluation platform that enables developers and domain experts to collaboratively build reliable AI applications faster.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/honeyhive/.

## Actions

- **Add datapoints to dataset**: Add datapoints to a dataset.
- **Create Dataset**: Create a dataset.
- **Create Tool**: Create a new tool.
- **Delete Datapoint**: Delete a specific datapoint by its ID.
- **Delete Dataset**: Delete a dataset by ID.
- **End Evaluation Run**: Mark an evaluation run as completed.
- **Get Configurations** (read-only): Retrieve a list of configurations.
- **Get Datasets** (read-only): Retrieve a list of datasets.
- **Get Metrics** (read-only): Retrieve all metrics.
- **Get Projects** (read-only): Retrieve projects.
- **List Tools** (read-only): List all available Honeyhive tools.
- **Retrieve Datapoint** (read-only): Retrieve a specific datapoint by its ID.
- **Retrieve Datapoints** (read-only): Retrieve a list of datapoints.
- **Retrieve Events** (read-only): Retrieve events by filters.
- **Retrieve Experiment Result** (read-only): Retrieve the result of a specific experiment run.
- **Start Evaluation Run**: Initiate an evaluation run using external datasets.
- **Start Session**: Start a new session.
- **Update Datapoint**: Update a specific datapoint.
- **Update Dataset**: Update an existing dataset.
- **Update Event**: Update an event.
- **Update Metric**: Update an existing metric.
- **Update Project**: Update a project's name or description.
- **Create Batch Model Events**: Create multiple model events in a single request.
- **Create Batch Tool Events**: Log a batch of external API calls as tool events.
